title: Dozens displaced by building collapse in Springfield
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A severe storm caused a building collapse in Springfield, displacing 45 residents; no injuries were reported.
Mayor Domenic J. Sarno declared a state of emergency, as the storm caused widespread power outages and downed trees.
The Red Cross and Eversource crews assisted residents, with electricity mostly restored to the affected areas.

title: Adam Vinatieri jokes about Bill Belichick, Deflategate as part of Hall-of-Fame speech
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adam Vinatieri was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame, reflecting on his 24-year NFL career.
Vinatieri joked about Bill Belichick missing the ceremony due to his role at University of North Carolina.
He humorously referenced Deflategate, thanking support staff including a ball boy, during his speech.

title: Mass. 7-year-old hit and killed by vehicle while riding bike
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 7-year-old child was fatally struck by a vehicle while riding a bicycle in Williamstown, Mass. on Friday.
The accident occurred at the intersection of Main Street and Buxton Hill Road around 5:40 p.m., according to officials.
No arrests or charges have been made; the driver was not impaired and the incident is still under investigation.

title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials advise against swimming in Ames Pond after a dog died possibly due to toxic algae.
Weekly E. Coli tests at Ames Pond show no issues, but algae blooms are suspected as the harmful element.
Cyanobacterial blooms, harmful to people and deadly to pets, may have rapidly formed in the pond.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Former NH State Trooper James Lamoureux pled guilty to making false reports about GPS devices on vehicles.
Lamoureux's six-month prison sentence was suspended for two years under a negotiated resolution.
He will resign, lose his certification, and be barred from law enforcement employment in future.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to Grace Chapel after receiving reports of a shirtless man with a gun.
The man was polishing a powder horn, a musket-era gunpowder container, outside his vehicle.
Police confirmed there was no threat to the public, and the building was placed on lockdown as a precaution.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker remains skeptical about the Red Sox making the playoffs despite their strong mid-season performance.
The Red Sox are currently holding the second A.L. wild-card spot with playoff odds at 96%, per FanGraphs.
The team achieved an MLB-best 27-3 record since July 3, following a 15-game winning streak in early July.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Red Sox's Wilyer Abreu was a late scratch from Saturday's lineup due to leg swelling after a hit on Friday.
Manager Chad Tracy hopes Abreu will return for Sunday's game; his condition will be assessed in the morning.
Abreu has 20 home runs and 62 RBIs this season, playing a key role both offensively and in right field.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Boston Red Sox's nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Athletics on Saturday.
Starting pitcher Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs over 5.1 innings, contributing to the team's sixth loss in 38 games.
Boston maintained the second American League wild-card spot, trailing the New York Yankees by 1.5 games.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is replacing its turf again due to NFL rules after recent installation post-World Cup.
The stadium's new surface failed NFL lab testing because it lacks an 'E-layer,' unlike usual stadium setups.
The turf installed will be the pre-World Cup version, used by the Patriots and Revolution in 2025.
